source_title: Full stress stratifications determine a labelled graph
author: Alec Kriebel
full_original_abstract: For a simple labelled graph, consider the full configuration space, including vertex collisions, partitioned into connected components of coordinate-sign equivalence classes of self-stress spaces. We prove that two graphs induce identical partitions precisely when their edge sets agree. More explicitly, an edge is recovered by asking whether its collision diagonal is a union of strata. This answers the literal equality formulation of Karpenkov's Problem 4. The proof combines the known singleton-support collision criterion with an explicit positive diagonal transport along a collinear path. The comparison convention is essential: nonisomorphic trees can have ambient-linearly equivalent stratifications.

claim.quantifiers: All integers n,d>=1; every simple graph on the same fixed labelled vertex set [n], including isolated or unused vertices.
claim.configuration: The entire X=(R^d)^n, including collisions, self-intersections and deficient affine spans.
claim.stress: One real coordinate per unordered edge with w_ij=w_ji and equilibrium sum_j w_ij(p_j-p_i)=0 at every vertex.
claim.same_graph_equivalence: A homeomorphism between whole stress spaces preserving the sign of every edge coordinate, including zero; it need not be linear.
claim.strata: Connected components of those same-graph equivalence classes.
claim.edge_detector: For every i!=j, {i,j} is an edge iff its named diagonal Delta_ij={P:p_i=p_j} is a union of whole strata.
claim.literal_partition_theorem: S_d(G)=S_d(H) as collections of subsets of the same fixed labelled X iff E(G)=E(H).
claim.corollary: A specified permutation carries partitions exactly when it carries graphs.

proof_fidelity.edge: A stress positive on one edge and zero elsewhere exists exactly when that edge collapses; its sign-support pattern is preserved in both directions.
proof_fidelity.nonedge: p_i(t)=t a,p_j(t)=0,p_k(t)=(k+1)a for others, a!=0, t in[-1/2,1/2]. No actual edge collapses; edge scalar differences have constant nonzero signs.
proof_fidelity.transport: W_G(P(t))=ker(B_G D_t); T_t=D_t^{-1}D_0 is positive diagonal and invertible, with inverse D_0^{-1}D_t.
proof_fidelity.connectedness: The continuous path lies in one equivalence class; its connected image lies in one connected component. No assumption that the entire class is path connected.
proof_fidelity.crossing: P(0) lies on Delta_ij while P(1/4) does not.
proof_fidelity.full_space: The collinear witness is inside the full space; it does not narrow the theorem to collinear configurations.
proof_fidelity.boundary: n=1 has only the empty simple graph; edgeless stress spaces are zero; isolates, disconnected graphs, d=1 and arbitrary edge orientations stay within scope.

ambient_counterexample.reason: Forest stresses are arbitrary precisely on collapsed edges. The invertible linear map sends path differences to the star differences and carries connected strata, while degree multisets differ.
ambient_counterexample.conclusion: Nonisomorphic trees can have ambient-linearly equivalent stratifications; their fixed-label literal partitions remain unequal.
